ideas.title: Investigation into Trump Administration's Handling of 2020 Election
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's handling of the 2020 election and potential wrongdoing
questions: What did the Trump administration know about the 2020 election?
Was there any wrongdoing in the administration's handling of the election?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and to shed light on the Trump administration's actions during the 2020 election. I recommend pursuing this story and conducting further research to determine the extent of the administration's involvement.
